title: Monkey in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- scarf tails -->
  <path d='M62 58 L74 66 L70 72 L60 64 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <path d='M60 64 L70 72 L66 78 L56 70 Z' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#d9a066'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='68' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='68' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='76' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#d9a066'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='76' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#d9a066'/>
  <!-- scarf wrap -->
  <rect x='30' y='53' width='40' height='11' rx='5' fill='#e63946'/>
  <rect x='30' y='53' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='38' r='9' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='38' r='9' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='38' r='5' fill='#d9a066'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='38' r='5' fill='#d9a066'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='21' fill='#8b5a2b'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f2c58a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='4.5' fill='#3b2412'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='4.5' fill='#3b2412'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='31.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='31.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 46 Q50 51 57 46' stroke='#a0522d' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hair tuft -->
  <path d='M50 15 Q46 9 52 10 Q54 6 56 12' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
</svg>
